name: friction
description: Runs friction on Claude's replies: deterministic fixes for LLM prose tells, applied before each reply is stored.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: fix rewrites each reply with friction's fixes; check only counts what friction would change; off does nothing.

command.title: friction command
command.description: The command that runs friction, split on spaces. Empty: `friction` on PATH, else `npx -y friction-cli@latest`.

subagents.title: Subagent replies
subagents.description: Also run friction on subagents' replies, which only the main model reads.
